groups.defect: The new downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts) definition replaces the earlier five-argument downsize in Ruby, so existing callers that pass width and height (e.g. ResizeEmoji) now raise ArgumentError.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same redefinition in optimized_image.rb and describe the same broken legacy signature.

groups.defect: The client hard-codes a 10 MB maximum in its file-too-large messages (in the pre-upload size check and in the 413 handler) instead of using the server's configurable max_image_size_kb, so users can be shown the wrong limit.
groups.rationale: It is the same hard-coded 10*1024 replacing the site setting, repeated at two places in utilities.js, and one change of approach fixes both.
